sections.Profile:
"Family Fun!" and "Star Strip" are both cocktail table pinball machines produced by Game Plan Inc. in 1979. Designed by Ed Cebula and Wendell McAdams, with artwork by Dick White, these games are known for their unique design and use of the Game Plan MPU-1 system. Although the playfields for both machines are essentially the same, they feature different artwork to cater to different themes.

- Manufacturer: Game Plan Inc.
- Years made: 1979
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: Alphanumeric
- Players: 4
